comment: Numeric attributes the real HN Algolia index accepts in numericFilters (its numericAttributesForFiltering setting). Verified live 2026-07-09: points, num_comments, created_at, story_id, parent_id all return 400. The mock server enforces this whitelist so CI rejects queries the real API would reject; hn-client.contract.test.ts re-verifies each entry against the live API when RUN_CONTRACT_TESTS=1.
